dosir.intro: What the research found about Perjaya Weir and its river. Each figure carries a letter for how we know it and the numbers of its sources (listed at the end).
dosir.lead_floods: Dated events from reports and the press; press items are marked P.
dosir.lead_identity: A gated weir (a barrage), not a dam: it raises the river a few metres and turns part of it into the canal; it stores almost nothing.
dosir.lead_irrigation: The weir feeds one of the largest irrigation systems of South Sumatra; several area figures exist because they measure different things.
dosir.lead_money: Built with Japanese loans in stages since 1989; operated by the central government.
dosir.lead_operation: The operating rules come from a student paper quoting the manual; no gate log or pond record is published.
dosir.lead_people: Who lives along the river near the weir.
dosir.lead_river: Flows at the weir are long-term figures from the old Martapura gauge and later studies; no flow record at the weir is public.
dosir.lead_standins: This is a model. These are the places where it uses something other than a survey or a gauge.
dosir.lead_structure: Gate sizes come from the operation and maintenance manual as quoted by later reports; levels the drawings would give are marked A where we had to assume them.
dosir.lead_upstream: Lake Ranau feeds the river in the dry season through a regulating weir; a large storage dam is being built on a tributary.
dosir.sec_standins: What stands in for a survey
dosir.snippet_only: seen as a search snippet only

ringkas.intro_1: Perjaya Weir holds back the Komering River near Martapura and turns part of it into the canal that waters the rice fields of OKU Timur.
ringkas.intro_2: Here rain over the basin becomes river flow; you operate the gates and see the pond, the canal and the river below respond.
ringkas.intro_2_maker: In this mode you place a dam of your own on any river of the basin and watch the lake fill over simulated years.
ringkas.standin_bays: Where no drawing gives a dimension or the order of the bays, the value is assumed and marked A.

ringkas.standin_rain: Rain is a reanalysis of the whole basin, not rain gauges.
ringkas.standin_terrain: The ground is a 30 m surface model that includes tree tops and roofs, not a survey of the bare ground.
